# Grand Sumo Banzuke

> An unofficial English and Japanese viewer of the grand sumo banzuke (番付), the ranking sheet the Japan Sumo Association publishes before each of the six yearly tournaments. One page, https://banzuke.app/, shows all six divisions, each wrestler's rise or fall since the last tournament, and the day-by-day results while a tournament is on. Data is refreshed from sumo.or.jp every day.

## Data

The page draws these plain JSON files; they are the same data, refreshed on every deploy.

- [Makuuchi and Juryo banzuke](https://banzuke.app/latest-banzuke.json): the current top two divisions, ranks, sides, stables and birthplaces, in English and Japanese
- [Makushita to Jonokuchi banzuke](https://banzuke.app/latest-lower.json): the four lower divisions
- [Archive index](https://banzuke.app/banzuke/index.json): earlier tournaments, each in `banzuke/<id>.json`
- Results: per tournament at `https://banzuke.app/results/<id>.json` (the id is in the banzuke file), with records, bouts, the yusho and special prizes

## Notes

- Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with the Japan Sumo Association. Rankings and results come from sumo.or.jp.
